Privacy policy

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: review by Rebel before launch. This is a structure based on what the website actually collects, not legal advice.]

Who we are

Rebel Detail & Valeting is a mobile car valeting and detailing business based in North Leeds. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: trading name and legal entity, e.g. sole trader or registered company with number] You can contact us about your data at rebelvalet@gmail.com or on 07469 184950.

What we collect

When you ask for a quote using the form on this website, we collect the details you enter: the service you're interested in, your vehicle's make and model, your postcode, your preferred date, your name, your mobile number, and optionally your email address, photos of your vehicle and any message you add.

If you contact us by phone, WhatsApp or email, we receive the details you choose to send.

How we use it

  • To reply to your enquiry and give you a price
  • To arrange and carry out your booking, including finding your address on the day
  • To keep basic records of the work we've done and payments, as required for tax purposes

We use your details because you've asked us to quote for or carry out work (taking steps before entering into a contract, and performing that contract), and to keep records we're legally required to hold. We don't sell your details or use them for marketing unless you've asked us to.

Who else handles your data

Your rights

You have the right to ask for a copy of the information we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict or object to how we use it, and to ask for it in a portable format. Contact us using the details above.

If you're unhappy with how we've handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
